name: @falling-ts/dsh-chinese
description: DSH Cordis plugin: appends three standing rules to the system prompt of every model request, each opening with a bolded one-line digest of its core requirement — all thinking and temporary output must be written in Chinese while code and symbols keep their original form, every file edit must go through the file-editing tools rather than a command or script, which may only verify an edit, and a verification script must run inline (here-document or -e) instead of being written to a temporary file first.
